steps.title: Gather materials and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect all listed items: 150 mm dish (Corning, cat 430599), 100 mm dish (Corning, cat 430167), 6‑well flat‑bottom plates (Corning, cat CLS3335), micron powder food (Sera), 27 G needle tip (Terumo, cat NN‑2719S), plastic tea strainer, transgenic zebrafish lines Tg(fabp10a:mCherry‑T2A‑Twist1a‑ER T2) and Tg(fabp10a:TA;TRE:xmrk;krt4:GFP), doxycycline (Sigma, D9891), 4‑hydroxytamoxifen (4‑OHT, Sigma, H6278), methylcellulose (Sigma, M7027), phenoxyethanol (Sigma, 77699), NaCl, KCl, MgSO₄·7H₂O, CaCl₂ (all Sigma), and the prepared stock solutions and media described in the Recipes section.

steps.title: Spawn embryos and maintain larvae
steps.instruction: Night before Day 0, place 6–8 pairs of heterozygous male xmrk and female Twist1a‑ER T2 fish in a breeding tank with a divider; in the morning remove the divider, let them spawn, collect embryos with a plastic tea strainer, transfer to a 150 mm dish containing E3 medium, discard dead embryos with a pipette, and incubate at 27 °C for six days, changing E3 daily and removing dead embryos each time.

substeps.instruction: Arrange 6–8 pairs (one pair per tank) of 3–9 month‑old adults.
Remove divider early morning to allow spawning.
Scoop embryos with tea strainer into 150 mm dish with E3.
Pipette out any dead embryos.
Incubate at 27 °C; change E3 medium and remove dead embryos daily for six days.

steps.title: Feed larvae and transfer to 6‑well plates
steps.instruction: From 5 days post‑fertilization (dpf) onward, each morning dilute a pinch of micron powder in 1 mL E3 and add to the larvae; between 8 and 11 dpf transfer larvae (no more than 100 per 150 mm plate after 6 dpf, 100–300 allowed at 6 dpf) into individual wells of a 6‑well plate, adding a few drops of fresh E3 each morning.

substeps.instruction: Prepare feeding solution: pinch of micron powder + 1 mL E3; add to larvae each morning.
At 8–11 dpf, place ≤100 larvae per 150 mm plate (or ≤100 per well after transfer).
Transfer larvae to wells of a 6‑well plate; add a few drops of fresh E3 each morning.

steps.title: Collect double‑transgenic larvae (Day 6)
steps.instruction: Place larvae in a 50 mL tube, anesthetize with 2 % (v/v) phenoxyethanol added to the E3‑micron powder suspension (final phenoxyethanol 0.02 %), spread them on a lid of a 150 mm dish, visualize under a fluorescence microscope, pipette out GFP‑positive fish (skin), then among those select mCherry‑positive fish (liver), transfer the selected fish to a fresh 150 mm dish with E3, and keep them for two days at 27 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 % phenoxyethanol (v/v) to the E3‑micron powder containing the fish; final phenoxyethanol concentration = 0.02 %.
Array fish on a lid of a 150 mm dish.
Under fluorescence, collect GFP‑positive larvae (skin).
From GFP‑positive pool, collect those also mCherry‑positive (liver).
Transfer selected larvae to a new 150 mm dish with E3.
Incubate at 27 °C for 2 days.

steps.title: Induce primary tumor with doxycycline (Day 8)
steps.instruction: Aliquot up to 100 larvae into a 150 mm plate containing 100 mL E3; add doxycycline to a final concentration of 30 µg/mL (add 100 µL of 30 mg/mL doxycycline stock to 100 mL E3) and treat for three days, refreshing the doxycycline‑containing E3 every two days.

substeps.instruction: Place ≤100 larvae in a 150 mm plate with 100 mL E3.
Add doxycycline stock (30 mg/mL) 100 µL per 100 mL E3 → 30 µg/mL final.
Treat for 3 days; change medium with doxycycline every 2 days.

steps.title: Add test chemicals (Day 11)
steps.instruction: At 8–11 dpf, move ~20 larvae into each well of a 6‑well plate containing 8 mL E3 with doxycycline (30 µg/mL); add each test compound to a final concentration of 5 µM using a 10 mM DMSO stock (add 4 µL stock diluted in 100 µL E3 to the well).

substeps.instruction: Aliquot ~20 larvae per well of a 6‑well plate with 8 mL E3 + 30 µg/mL doxycycline.
Prepare test‑chemical working solution: 4 µL of 10 mM DMSO stock diluted in 100 µL E3.
Add the 100 µL diluted solution to each well to reach 5 µM final concentration.

steps.title: Induce metastasis with 4‑OHT (Day 11.5)
steps.instruction: Twelve hours after adding the test chemicals, treat the larvae with 0.1 µM 4‑OHT in E3 for five days; change the medium (containing doxycycline, 4‑OHT, and the test chemical) every two days.

substeps.instruction: 12 h post‑chemical addition, add 4‑OHT to reach 0.1 µM final concentration.
Maintain treatment for 5 days.
Replace medium with fresh doxycycline + 4‑OHT + test chemical every 2 days.

steps.title: Prepare stock solutions and media
steps.instruction: Make the following solutions: Doxycycline stock – dissolve 500 mg doxycycline in 10 mL ddH₂O (50 mg/mL); 4‑OHT stock – dissolve 387 mg 4‑OHT in 1 L ethanol (100 mM); E3 medium – per 1 L add 0.292 g NaCl (5 mM), 0.013 g KCl (0.17 mM), 0.081 g MgSO₄·7H₂O (0.33 mM), 0.048 g CaCl₂ (0.33 mM) and bring to 1 L with ddH₂O; 30 % methylcellulose – dissolve 30 g methylcellulose in 100 mL ddH₂O; phenoxyethanol 0.02 % – add 20 µL phenoxyethanol to 100 mL ddH₂O.

substeps.instruction: Doxycycline stock: 500 mg → 10 mL ddH₂O → 50 mg/mL.
4‑OHT stock: 387 mg → 1 L ethanol → 100 mM.
E3 medium (1 L): 0.292 g NaCl, 0.013 g KCl, 0.081 g MgSO₄·7H₂O, 0.048 g CaCl₂; adjust volume to 1 L with ddH₂O.
30 % methylcellulose: 30 g methylcellulose + 70 g ddH₂O → 100 mL total.
Phenoxyethanol 0.02 % (v/v): 20 µL phenoxyethanol + 100 mL ddH₂O.
